QuestInfo.0: You've heard about the day of the invasion, but you still don't know why the Black Mage invaded Kritias in the first place. Ask Ione.
QuestInfo.2: You decided to ask #bHirrel#k why Kritias was invaded.

0.0:
My father's disappearance isn't the only mystery. #bWhy did the Black Mage invade Kritias?#k #bWhy is the castle floating in the sky?#k 
#L0##bHe must be after something unique to Kritias.#l
#L1#He's making an example out of you.#l
#k
0.1: Kritias has always been known for its magic. Students would travel from all over to study at the #bRanheim Academy#k. Was he after our magic...?\r\n#L0##bWhat kind of magic is it?#l\n#k
0.2: Magic isn't exactly my area of expertise. Hirrel will know more about Kritias's history and Beatrice can tell you about magic. \r\nI suggest you begin with #bHirrel#k. He may know what the Black Mage is after.

0.1: Maybe, but Kritias was never a major threat to the Black Mage. Why didn't he target a more active kingdom like Ereve instead?

yes.0: #bHirrel#k is near the town hall. I think he can answer any questions you have about Kritias.

no.0: I'm sorry, but that's all I know.

yes.0: What a pleasant surprise. I was just looking for you. Welcome!

npc.0: Hirrel is waiting near the town hall. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must return to my... serving boy duties.
